const keys = ["foo"];
Object.defineProperty(keys, 0, {get() {console.log("get"); return "bar";}});
console.log(JSON.stringify({foo: 1, bar: 2}, keys));
const inheritedKeys = new Array(1);
Object.setPrototypeOf(inheritedKeys, Object.create(Array.prototype, {0: {value: "bar"}}));
console.log(JSON.stringify({foo: 1, bar: 2}, inheritedKeys));
const growing = ["first"];
Object.defineProperty(growing, 0, {get() {growing.push("second"); return "first";}});
console.log(JSON.stringify({first: 1, second: 2}, growing));
